user.title: Connect to UniFi
user.description: Use a UniFi API key (UniFi OS: Network → Settings → Control Plane → Integrations), a local-only admin account without two-factor authentication, or both. With both, the key is tried first and the account is the fallback.

data_description.url: UDM / UDR / UCG / Cloud Key: https://192.168.1.1. Standalone Network app: https://host:8443
data_description.site: Leave as 'default' unless you have several UniFi sites
data_description.username: Optional with an API key. Recommended as a fallback: some UniFi versions only accept keys for part of the API.

error.invalid_auth: UniFi rejected the API key or the username/password.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the UniFi console at that address.
error.need_auth: Enter an API key, or a username and password.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Family WiFi is already set up.

menu_options.group: Add or edit a kid or group

group_edit.title: Kid or group
group_edit.description: Pick their devices. On iPhones and iPads, turn off Private Wi-Fi Address for your home network so the device keeps the same address.

websites_edit.title: Website list
websites_edit.description: One domain per line. Subdomains are blocked too. Blocking only works when the devices use your UniFi gateway for DNS.

speeds.title: Slow-down speeds
speeds.description: One per line: Name = download/upload in kbps. The first one is used by the Slow down switch.

limits_edit.title: Daily limits for {kid}

error.bad_domains: Enter domains like youtube.com, one per line.
error.bad_apps: Use lines like: Youtube = 60, Video (the website list must exist).

abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach UniFi to list devices.

pause.name: Pause internet
pause.description: Block a kid, group or device from the internet, optionally for a while.

target.name: Who
target.description: Kid, group or device name as set up in Family WiFi.

duration.name: How long
duration.description: e.g. 30 min, 2 hours, until 7am, until I undo.

slow_down.name: Slow down
slow_down.description: Limit the internet speed of a kid, group or device.

duration.name: How long
duration.description: e.g. 30 min, 2 hours, until 7am, until I undo.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: One of your slow-down speeds. Defaults to the first.

block_websites.name: Block websites
block_websites.description: Block a website list, or specific domains, for a kid, group or device.

duration.name: How long
duration.description: e.g. 30 min, 2 hours, until 7am, until I undo.

websites.name: Websites
websites.description: A website list name (e.g. Games) or domains separated by commas.

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Remove restrictions from a kid, group or device.

only.name: Only
only.description: Undo just this kind. Leave empty to undo everything.

status.name: Status
status.description: Returns a summary of what's active and when it ends.

extra_time.name: Give extra time
extra_time.description: Add minutes to a kid's daily limits for today and lift any limit that already kicked in.
